details:
Bug Report

My VRChat generated a log file larger than 1 GB, filled with a massive number of error messages.

In my settings, "Allow Untrusted URLs" is disabled.

After I left that world and refreshed the log, the log stopped accumulating new errors.

I idled in the world for >6 hours, which produced a log file over 1 GB.

Later, idling for 4 hours produced a log file of over 500 MB.

World ID: `wrld_d8a95038-5687-464c-881b-150d0f2e7b01`

By looking at the beginning of the log, about half an hour after joining the world, the errors started endlessly.
